ledger.why: protection note: the Chief is cast as the special tribal_chief role, which no effect harms; the event has no effect

items.text: "My fellow villagers, today we honor the work of many hands..."
"There comes a time in every village's history..."
"I have prepared a few words. Actually, quite a few."
The Chief laughs and finishes the speech in (chief.his/her) own words. The villagers applaud warmly.
The elder quietly helps retrieve the notes. The ceremony resumes.
The child is promised snacks AFTER the speech. The Chief then decides that a shorter speech might be wise.
The Chief abandons the speech and invites villagers to share their own stories. Several speak with unexpected eloquence.
The Chief delivers the entire shopping list without noticing. The crowd is baffled but impressed by the passion shown for beans.
The speech ends quietly. Later, the Chief tells a friend that leadership is sometimes less about appearing impressive than being willing to laugh at oneself.
a child loudly asks when the snacks will be served
a gust of wind carries away the speech notes
the Chief realizes (chief.he/she) is holding a shopping list
an elder starts applauding halfway through the first sentence
a nearby bird perfectly imitates the Chief's voice
the Chief forgets a carefully rehearsed phrase and improvises
a father gently rocks his baby, who begins squeaking precisely whenever the Chief pauses

speech.name: The speech
speech.text:
The tribal Chief has prepared a speech celebrating the village's progress. It is supposed to be {short and inspiring|formal and dignified|heartfelt and personal}. The entire village gathers to listen.
The Chief begins: {A}
